Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Willkommen im Bahntechnik Center Hägendorf. Hier montierst du Eisenbahnsignale, die jeden Tag viele Züge sicher führen. Du arbeitest mit hochwertigen mechanischen Komponenten, präzise und zuverlässig, und freust dich über jedes fertig geprüfte Signal. Ob eigenständig oder im Team, deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf einen sicheren und pünktlichen Bahnverkehr. Dich erwartet ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld mit Verantwortung und sichtbarer Wirkung. Du profitierst von einem topmodernen Arbeitsplatz, einer Kantine mit fairen Preisen, kostenloser Arbeitskleidung inklusive Reinigung und attraktiven Zulagen für Familien. Wir fördern deine Weiterentwicklung in der Signaltechnik und in der Produktion.
Benefits: Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Monteur:in Eisenbahnsignale montierst, verdrahtest und prüfst du Signale sowie signaltechnische Baugruppen und trägst damit direkt zur sicheren und pünktlichen Bahn bei.
- Mechanische und elektrotechnische Montagearbeiten führst du nach Vorgaben, technischen Zeichnungen und Montageplänen aus und dokumentierst die Arbeiten sauber.
- Du führst Funktionskontrollen durch und stellst die Qualität der ausgeführten Arbeiten sicher.
- In KAIZEN-, 5S- und weiteren Verbesserungsinitiativen wirkst du aktiv mit und trägst zur Weiterentwicklung von Abläufen im Team bei.
- Du gewährleistest Ordnung und Sauberkeit am Arbeitsplatz nach 5S und stellst Materialien fachgerecht bereit.
- Im Team arbeitest du gerne mit anderen zusammen, wickelst aber Einzelaufträge problemlos eigenständig ab, wobei du stets die geltenden Sicherheits- und Qualitätsrichtlinien einhältst.
Das bringst du mit.
- Präzise Arbeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Disziplin zeichnen dich aus; zudem bringst du ein hohes Verantwortungs- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein mit.
- Die Zusammenarbeit im Team macht dir Freude, gleichzeitig kannst du Aufgaben selbstständig planen und umsetzen und Verbesserungen (KAIZEN / 5S) aktiv mitgestalten.
- Praktische Erfahrung in der Montage oder Baugruppenfertigung ist von Vorteil; ausserdem bist du sicher im Lesen von technischen Zeichnungen und Richtlinien.
- Vorhanden ist eine abgeschlossene mechanische Grundausbildung EFZ, zum Beispiel als Automatiker:in, Automatikmonteur:in oder Polymechaniker:in Fachrichtung Montage, oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation.
- Grundkenntnisse in MS Office, insbesondere in Outlook, Excel und Word, runden dein Profil ab und Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift entsprechen mindestens dem Niveau B2.
Hier findest du einen Einblick in unser Bahntechnikcenter - BTC Hägendorf.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau E, Regionalzulage Stufe 0. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Meccanico automatico: a Hägendorf, 1 luglio 2026 o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora Puoi aspettarlo con ansia. Benvenuti al Centro tecnologico ferroviario di Hägendorf. Qui si assemblano i segnali ferroviari che ogni giorno guidano in sicurezza numerosi treni. Lavori con componenti meccanici di alta qualità, in modo preciso e affidabile e sei soddisfatto di ogni segnale completamente testato. Sia indipendentemente che in squadra, il vostro lavoro ha un impatto diretto sulla sicurezza e sulla puntualità del trasporto ferroviario. Ti aspetta un ambiente vario con responsabilità e impatto visibile. Approfittate di un posto di lavoro all'avanguardia, di una mensa a prezzi equi, di abiti da lavoro gratuiti con pulizia inclusa e di interessanti indennità per le famiglie. Promuoviamo il vostro ulteriore sviluppo nella tecnologia e nella produzione della segnalazione. Vantaggi: i vantaggi come AG gratuita, viaggi all'estero scontati - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce Vantaggi. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di installatore di segnali ferroviari, assembli, cabli e provi segnali e gruppi di segnalamento, contribuendo così direttamente alla sicurezza e alla puntualità delle ferrovie. - Esegui lavori di montaggio meccanico ed elettrico secondo specifiche, disegni tecnici e piani di montaggio e documenta il lavoro in modo chiaro. - Esegui controlli funzionali e garantisci la qualità del lavoro svolto. - Parteciperai attivamente a KAIZEN, 5S e altre iniziative di miglioramento e contribuirai all'ulteriore sviluppo dei processi nel team. - Garantisci l'ordine e la pulizia sul posto di lavoro secondo le 5S e fornisci i materiali in modo professionale. - Ti piace lavorare con gli altri in un team, ma puoi gestire facilmente i singoli ordini in modo indipendente, rispettando sempre le linee guida applicabili in materia di sicurezza e qualità. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Lavoro preciso, affidabilità e disciplina ti caratterizzano; Hai anche un alto senso di responsabilità e sicurezza. - Ti piace lavorare insieme in una squadra, ma allo stesso tempo puoi pianificare e implementare le attività in modo indipendente e contribuire attivamente a modellare i miglioramenti (KAIZEN / 5S). - Costituisce titolo preferenziale l'esperienza pratica nell'assemblaggio o nella produzione di componenti; Hai anche sicurezza nella lettura dei disegni tecnici e delle linee guida. - Avere completato la formazione meccanica di base (EFZ), ad esempio come tecnico automatico, meccanico automatico o polimeccanico specializzato in assemblaggio, o una qualifica equivalente. - La conoscenza di base di MS Office, in particolare Outlook, Excel e Word, completa il profilo e la conoscenza del tedesco parlato e scritto corrisponde almeno al livello B2. descriptionByLocale.en: Automatic mechanic:in 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Automatic mechanic:in Hägendorf, July 1st, 2026 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now You can look forward to this. Welcome to the Hägendorf Railway Technology Center. Here you assemble railway signals that safely guide many trains every day. You work with high-quality mechanical components, precisely and reliably, and are happy about every fully tested signal. Whether independently or in a team, your work has a direct impact on safe and punctual rail transport. A varied environment with responsibility and visible impact awaits you. You benefit from a state-of-the-art workplace, a canteen with fair prices, free work clothes including cleaning and attractive allowances for families. We promote your further development in signaling technology and production. Benefits: You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a railway signal fitter, you assemble, wire and test signals and signaling assemblies, thereby directly contributing to safe and punctual railways. - You carry out mechanical and electrical assembly work according to specifications, technical drawings and assembly plans and document the work clearly. - You carry out functional checks and ensure the quality of the work carried out. - You will actively participate in KAIZEN, 5S and other improvement initiatives and contribute to the further development of processes in the team. - You ensure order and cleanliness in the workplace according to 5S and provide materials professionally. - You enjoy working with others in a team, but can easily handle individual orders independently, always adhering to applicable safety and quality guidelines. This is what you bring with you. - Precise work, reliability and discipline characterize you; You also have a high sense of responsibility and safety. - You enjoy working together in a team, but at the same time you can plan and implement tasks independently and actively help shape improvements (KAIZEN / 5S). - Practical experience in assembly or component production is an advantage; You are also confident in reading technical drawings and guidelines. - You have completed basic mechanical training (EFZ), for example as an automatic technician, automatic mechanic or polymechanic specializing in assembly, or an equivalent qualification. - Basic knowledge of MS Office, especially Outlook, Excel and Word, rounds off your profile and knowledge of spoken and written German corresponds to at least level B2. Here you can find an insight into our railway technology center - BTC Hägendorf. Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. This is how you get started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. This is how it goes. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102578 Kevin Kiser Telephone +41 79 396 62 38 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. That's what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more
